prerequisites: review database-scoped PUBLIC TEMP revoke impact
statements: CREATE ROLE responseos_routing_worker_test NOLOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS CONNECTION LIMIT 4
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO responseos_routing_worker_test
DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE format('GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE %I TO responseos_routing_worker_test', current_database()); END $$
DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE format('REVOKE TEMPORARY ON DATABASE %I FROM PUBLIC', current_database()); END $$
GRANT SELECT (id), UPDATE (id) ON public."Account" TO responseos_routing_worker_test
GRANT SELECT ON public."FrlWebIntake",public."HostedRoutingDelivery",public."Notification",public."AuditLog" TO responseos_routing_worker_test

GRANT UPDATE (status,attempt_count,dispatch_token,lease_until,next_attempt_at,checkpoint_json,last_error_code,confirmed_at,updated_at) ON public."HostedRoutingDelivery" TO responseos_routing_worker_test
GRANT INSERT ON public."Notification",public."AuditLog" TO responseos_routing_worker_test

CREATE FUNCTION public.routing_worker_account_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF current_user = 'responseos_routing_worker_test' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'worker_account_mutation_forbidden'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER routing_worker_account_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON public."Account" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.routing_worker_account_immutable()
ALTER TABLE public."Account" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE public."FrlWebIntake" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE public."HostedRoutingDelivery" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE public."Notification" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE public."AuditLog" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY routing_worker_account ON public."Account" FOR SELECT TO responseos_routing_worker_test USING (id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic')

CREATE POLICY routing_worker_account_lock ON public."Account" FOR UPDATE TO responseos_routing_worker_test USING (id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic') WITH CHECK (id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic')
CREATE POLICY routing_worker_intake ON public."FrlWebIntake" FOR SELECT TO responseos_routing_worker_test USING (account_id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic' AND environment = 'test')

CREATE POLICY routing_worker_delivery ON public."HostedRoutingDelivery" FOR ALL TO responseos_routing_worker_test USING (account_id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic' AND mode = 'simulated' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."FrlWebIntake" i WHERE i.id = intake_id AND i.account_id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic' AND i.environment = 'test')) WITH CHECK (account_id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic' AND mode = 'simulated' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."FrlWebIntake" i WHERE i.id = intake_id AND i.account_id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic' AND i.environment = 'test'))

CREATE POLICY routing_worker_notice_read ON public."Notification" FOR SELECT TO responseos_routing_worker_test USING (account_id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic' AND channel = 'in_app' AND recipient = 'routing-operators' AND subject = 'Routing operator evidence' AND status = 'queued' AND id LIKE 'routing_%')

CREATE POLICY routing_worker_notice_insert ON public."Notification" FOR INSERT TO responseos_routing_worker_test WITH CHECK (account_id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic' AND channel = 'in_app' AND recipient = 'routing-operators' AND subject = 'Routing operator evidence' AND status = 'queued' AND id LIKE 'routing_%' AND message::jsonb->>'externalDelivery' = 'disabled' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."HostedRoutingDelivery" d WHERE d.id = message::jsonb->>'deliveryId' AND d.account_id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic'))

CREATE POLICY routing_worker_audit_read ON public."AuditLog" FOR SELECT TO responseos_routing_worker_test USING (account_id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic' AND actor_type = 'system' AND actor_user_id IS NULL AND target_type = 'HostedRoutingDelivery' AND action LIKE 'hosted_routing.%')

CREATE POLICY routing_worker_audit_insert ON public."AuditLog" FOR INSERT TO responseos_routing_worker_test WITH CHECK (account_id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic' AND actor_type = 'system' AND actor_user_id IS NULL AND target_type = 'HostedRoutingDelivery' AND action LIKE 'hosted_routing.%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."HostedRoutingDelivery" d WHERE d.id = target_id AND d.account_id = 'frl_routing_staging_synthetic'))
